notes: Sums the current gambling loss entries into the family subtotal that Schedule A line 16 reads. Guards its own collect: the family must be confirmed closed, so an unconfirmed family is SOURCE_SET_UNCLOSED and never a partial sum; closed-empty publishes zero. Publishes the sum with cents (the itemization-cents stance): the line that reads it rounds once. This is the raw, unlimited subtotal; the limit to winnings lives in rule.schedule-a-line16. The Schedule A attachment does not itemize it: an itemization part's rows must sum exactly to a published subtotal and tie out to its line, and a part cannot be skipped, so a part over this family would block every Schedule A itemizer that has no Form W-2G and could not hold a limited line. The subtotal is applicable only when a Form W-2G is recorded (otherwise the line 16 limit is zero and the losses family is not read), so a return with no winnings is held here, not blocked, and is never asked to confirm the family.
